text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well done, Trainer the Brave. Thou hast
saved
the Umamusume princesses.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Behold the fruits of thy labor. Princesses
from
across the realms owe their lives to
thee.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yet despite your triumph, dark clouds
shall
inevitably befall this world once
again...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In truth, these princesses were demon
lords all
along. I leave them under thy
watch until the Day
of Awakening
dawns.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, hero. Direct sunlight is their
only
weakness... Take care not to forget
the words of
Queen Golshi, brave one...
